name: interview-prep-plugin
description: Adaptive interview coaching with personalized courses and evidence-based progress.

interface.longDescription: Build long-term software engineering interview skills through a personalized course. Practice unfamiliar problems with progressive hints, exact-code review, spaced retrieval, and realistic mock interviews. Track independent performance separately from assisted learning across DSA, your chosen programming language, backend, databases, system design, and behavioral interviews. Imminent interviews can temporarily prioritize employer-provided topics. Learning state uses Markdown files in a filesystem-capable host; external notes integrations require separate setup. No personal learner history is included.
defaultPrompt: Continue my interview prep from the last session.
Start my course and ask about my language, notes, and goals.

publication.release_notes: Continuous daily sessions, return-and-resume starter prompts, one-time language and Obsidian/Markdown intake, and persistent resume-point tracking.
